description.zh: 16 个彩色简笔图标：保留清晰圆润的轮廓，用暖金、珊瑚、雾蓝和叶绿表现天气、植物、家居、交通与小动物。固定填色配合局部明暗和高光，轮廓跟随取色器；轻微局部动画支持暂停与减少动态，透明背景，80×80 画布。
description.en: 16 colorful, rounded line icons for weather, plants, home, transport and little animals. Warm gold, coral, mist blue and leaf green use fixed fills, local shading and highlights with adjustable outlines. Gentle localized motion supports pause and reduced motion on a transparent 80×80 canvas.

description.zh: 暖金色太阳有红润脸颊和左上高光，八束短光芒围着静止的笑脸缓缓转动。
description.en: A warm golden sun has rosy cheeks and an upper-left highlight; eight short rays rotate around its still smiling face.

description.zh: 奶油白云团带着蓝色底部暗面，左侧两道柔和高光，轻轻浮在浅浅的影子上。
description.en: A cream cloud with a blue shaded underside and two soft highlights floats above a faint shadow.

description.zh: 浅蓝云团下有三颗蓝色水滴轻摆，地上的小水洼留着两圈波纹。
description.en: Three blue drops sway below a pale blue cloud; two ripples sit in a small puddle below.

description.zh: 淡紫色弯月带有浅色内缘和两处小月坑，旁边两颗金色星芒静止，弯月轻轻弹起。
description.en: A lavender crescent with a pale inner edge and two small craters pops gently beside two still golden glints.

description.zh: 金色五角星带着同色暗面、白色高光和两颗小眼睛，中央主体轻轻呼吸。
description.en: A golden five-pointed star has warm shading, a white highlight and two small eyes; the star gently pulses.

description.zh: 圆润的绿树冠有分层叶色，木色树干刻着短木纹，树冠在两簇小草上轻轻呼吸。
description.en: A rounded green canopy has layered leaf colors above a wood-grained trunk and two grass tufts; only the canopy gently pulses.

description.zh: 珊瑚色五瓣花绕金色花心慢慢旋转，绿色茎叶长在一小块土堆上。
description.en: Five coral petals turn slowly around a golden center on a still green stem, with two leaves and a little mound of soil.

description.zh: 奶油色小屋有珊瑚瓦顶、蓝色十字窗和木门；烟囱上方的一缕淡蓝烟轻轻摇摆。
description.en: A cream cottage has a coral tiled roof, a blue crossbar window and a wooden door; a pale blue wisp sways above the chimney.

description.zh: 珊瑚红爱心带着右下暗面和左上弧形高光，伴着两颗小金色光点轻轻跳动。
description.en: A coral heart has a darker lower-right edge and a curved upper-left highlight; it pulses beside two small golden glints.

description.zh: 蓝色陶杯盛着深褐色热饮，坐在奶油色小碟上；一缕奶白蒸汽在杯口上方摇摆。
description.en: A blue ceramic cup holds a dark warm drink on a cream saucer; an ivory wisp sways above the rim.

description.zh: 薄荷绿自行车有蓝灰轮胎、奶油轮缘、棕色车座与金色轮毂，前轮的六根辐条缓缓转动。
description.en: A mint bicycle has blue-gray tires, cream rims, a brown saddle and golden hubs; six spokes turn slowly inside the front wheel.

description.zh: 珊瑚色小车有蓝色车窗、奶油车灯与深色轮胎，车身轻轻起伏，轮子和地面影子静止。
description.en: A coral car has blue windows, cream lamps and dark tires; the body gently pulses above still wheels and a ground shadow.

description.zh: 木色帆船带着奶油主帆和珊瑚小帆，随船身轻轻漂浮，船底两道蓝色水纹保持静止。
description.en: A wooden sailboat carries a cream mainsail and a small coral sail; the boat floats above two still blue ripples.

description.zh: 雾蓝色圆小鸟有奶油肚皮、珊瑚小嘴和带羽纹的翅膀，轻轻浮在一根带绿叶的树枝上方。
description.en: A round mist-blue bird has a cream belly, coral beak and feather marks on its wing; it hovers gently above a leafy twig.

description.zh: 金橙小鱼有珊瑚色尾鳍、分层鱼鳞和深色亮眼，身体轻轻呼吸，旁边冒着三颗浅蓝气泡。
description.en: A golden-orange fish has coral fins, layered scales and a dark glinting eye; it gently pulses beside three pale blue bubbles.

description.zh: 奶油色小猫脸带着橙色额纹、珊瑚耳心、深色亮眼和细胡须，头像在淡淡影子上轻轻弹起。
description.en: A cream kitten face has orange forehead stripes, coral inner ears, dark glinting eyes and fine whiskers; it pops gently above a faint shadow.
